hardGateFindings.finding: The packet distinguishes planned solicitation and outward job-search actions from completed outcomes and explicitly leaves recruiter comprehension, collaborator agreement, applications, interviews, and hiring unmeasured.

All eight blind spots map to owned observable controls and safe evidence returns; priority inquiries, role and proof ledgers, invisible-labor review, route budgets, reader escalation, and decision-digest requirements are bounded and traceable.
The packet identifies this as an LLM control evaluation rather than human testing, requires the unchanged independent repeat, and does not represent control-evaluator judgment as external validation.

Private reader feedback and relationship graphs are excluded from mosaic review, feedback remains private, mixed and first-person claims retain visible attribution, and evidence-return requirements are public-safe.

limitations: This run evaluates the stated frozen packet as an LLM control system; it is not a substitute for executing the five-person human reader protocol.
Recruiter comprehension, collaborator agreement, applications, interviews, hiring, and other external outcomes remain not-yet-measured.
The July 18 solicitation and July 21 outward job-search action are planned controls, not verified completed actions or outcomes.
Session and hashing provenance is auditable but not cryptographic.
